_note: 1.4.3 Trust (owner design, approved 2026-09-25; planning/DRAFT_trust.md). Single source for the engine (tools/gen_engine.py), the Now entry (tools/gen_mvu_entries.py) and the UI (tools/gen_ui.py). Trust = how sure an NPC is that {{user}} can be relied on; it decides what they dare give (secrets, risks, perks). bands: [from, name]. Rises only through reported deeds (kinds, x the category's rise, at most weekly_cap a week per NPC; each kind once a day) and +rank_up when a bond event raises the rank; the narrator writes drops directly (x the category's drop, never capped). Below floor it recovers by the category's recover each quiet week (no drop for 7 days). Categories come from data/bond_openness.json (open / guarded / closed; anyone else normal). perk_gates: rank -> Trust needed for that rank's perk and for the bond event that reaches it (the Rank 8 event is never held: under 50 it can only end in a sworn rivalry, and the Romance flag waits). A Rank 10 benefit is suspended below suspend_r10_below. spread: a drop of spread.at or more in one reply costs every Friends line of that NPC spread.friends Trust. dorm_head: easier bond, Tension and Trust with {{user}} while {{user}} lives in their dorm. 1.4.4 (owner): 'understood' (an interaction: the character finally understands {{user}} meant no harm) gives back the category's share of the last Trust drop, if it was within understood_days; once per drop; spread Trust does not come back. 1.6.8 (owner): the Rank 8 gate (perk_gates 8) holds the 7->8 event for characters with no rival branch (data/npc_canon.json branch C and D) until Trust reaches it; for A and B the event never waits, and under the gate it can only end in a sworn rivalry.

open.name: Open

bands.Doubtful: still friendly on the surface, but checks what {{user}} says against others and no longer shares anything important
bands.Betrayed: openly hurt and bewildered; tells friends what {{user}} did, because they cannot understand it
bands.Confidant: tells {{user}} everything, often too much; takes {{user}}'s word over anyone's

open.never: holding a grudge in secret or plotting against {{user}}

bands.Doubtful: polite but careful: keeps plans vague, asks for things in writing, does not lend or cover
bands.Betrayed: cold and formal; answers only what they must and keeps their distance
bands.Confidant: relies on {{user}} and says so; asks {{user}}'s opinion before anyone else's

bands.Doubtful: says nothing personal; watches {{user}}'s hands, not {{user}}'s face; tests {{user}} with small things
bands.Betrayed: closes completely: {{user}} becomes one more person they were right not to trust
bands.Confidant: lets the guard down only with {{user}}: a rare, quiet honesty that others never see

closed.name: Closed

bands.Doubtful: assumes {{user}} wants something; every kindness is weighed for its price
bands.Betrayed: files {{user}} as a threat and acts on it, within their position and nature
bands.Confidant: treats {{user}} as the one exception to a lifelong rule; would deny it if asked

closed.never: saying out loud that they trust {{user}}

Etnie.text: Etnie cannot stop trusting her "little sibling": her Trust never falls below 50 and her perks never wait on it; a betrayal wounds her instead (the engine turns the rest of the drop into Tension).

Kanae.text: Kanae's trust feeds on {{user}} pulling away from others for her: when {{user}} turns someone down or distances themselves from a friend for her, report {"With": "Kanae", "Kind": "choose"}. While her Plan is hidden she never counts {{user}} as a betrayer.

Althair.text: Althair trusts no one and needs no one's trust: his Trust stays 50 and his perks never wait on it; betraying him only entertains him (the engine turns it into bond XP).

Caine.text: Caine despises mages, {{user}} included: his Trust cannot pass 64 until his own secret has come out and {{user}} still treats him the same.

Ottavio.text: {{user}} is one of Ottavio's Sky students: he forgives them faster, trusts them sooner, and it shows.
